The pipeline transforms raw multimodal sensor recordings into a trained
plant-based emotion classifier.

## Sensor Setup

Plant electrodes, a camera, a Polar H10 chest strap, and an SCD41 CO~2~
sensor.

## Field Work

Fifteen participants each completed one session while watching a fixed
sequence of emotion-eliciting clips.

## Labeling Algorithm

Valence is derived from facial expression; arousal from HRV. The two
axes are crossed into a five-class emotion label.

## Feature Engineering

Every session is labeled and merged into one consolidated,
machine-learning-ready dataset.

## Machine Learning Models

Random Forest, XGBoost, and a neural network are trained per target
variable, using only plant-bioelectric features.
